newsitem.title: USA: Gas line ignites outside Indianapolis.
newsitem.headline: Gas line ignites outside Indianapolis.

text.p: A natural gas line ignited and set fire to several homes in a suburb outside Indianapolis on Monday, authorities said.
Police said the blaze was still burning and fire departments from around the area had responded.
According to broadcast reports, a half-dozen homes caught fire. There were no immediate reports of casualties.
The cause of the blaze in a largely residential area northeast of Indianapolis was not immediately known.
